meta.title: Where Your World Comes From
meta.subtitle: Nobody calls new World. A reflection scan picks one owner, and everything after that is a census

views.label: Who owns creation
views.note: One reflection scan, most-derived type wins, and returning true means Unity builds nothing of its own.

views.label: A world is a census result
views.note: Every world asks the same question with different flags and gets a different list of systems back.

views.label: What Nerve adds
views.note: Netcode decides whether client and server worlds exist. Nerve decides when.

views.label: Becoming a frame
views.note: Three groups are spliced into three player loop phases. That is the only reason a system ever runs.

cards.title: Default means two different things
items: Populating a world, it expands to LocalSimulation plus Presentation · Types/TypeManagerSystems.cs:817
Classifying a system, it walks up the UpdateInGroup chain instead
A chain ending at a group with no parent falls back to local, server and client · Types/TypeManagerSystems.cs:1386
SimulationSystemGroup carries no filter at all · DefaultWorld.cs:683, so most chains end there

cards.title: The ownership contract
items: The scan collects every type deriving from the bootstrap interface · DefaultWorldInitialization.cs:424
The most derived candidate wins; an unrelated tie is an error, not a merge · :447
Return true and Unity returns your world immediately · :161
Return false, or do not exist, and it builds one plain world instead · :170

cards.title: What a world actually is
items: The three root groups are created unconditionally, before any of your systems · :314
A system with no group attribute lands in simulation, not nowhere · :294
Each root group is sorted once, after the whole list has been placed · :321
The world only becomes a frame when its groups are appended to the player loop · :176

cards.title: The layer above netcode
items: Netcode decides whether client and server worlds exist at all
Nerve decides when they are built and when they are thrown away
Its service world is constructed once with a filter bit of its own · BovineLabs.Nerve/Utility/BovineLabsBootstrap.cs:214
It then hand-picks the Unity scene and entity systems it wants alongside · :227
